# A Calendar preference timer turn does not establish target visibility

The owned helper change yields through prefsWindow.setTimeout and logs paneID/scrollPaneTo before returning the preference document and window. Current openPreferencesTab awaits selectPrefPane, but selectPrefPane calls showTab, whose scrollIntoView runs in a later timer with no returned completion promise. The Calendar helper also checks positive scroll only for a requested target in an overflowing container. Those are separate completion boundaries: a timer turn or positive scroll alone does not assert that the target is in view and ready for a click. Keep the exact caller condition when using this helper; this source does not establish that the historical intermittent failure is cured or that one timer turn is a general readiness rule.

Scope: calendar/preferences/tests.
